slides.headline: Buy now, pick up whenever
slides.line: Save it to My Spot at the member price. It waits there for you.

slides.headline: Get in without the queue
slides.line: Buy entry or a line skip, then show it at the door. Some places scan instead.

slides.headline: Two ways to collect
slides.line: The kitchen pings you when it is ready. Or show your phone and they hand it over.

slides.headline: More of your week
slides.line: The barber, the corner store, and the rest of where you already go.

slides.headline: Members-only nights
slides.line: TapIn throws them, from local bands to touring headliners. You bring someone.

slides.headline: Points that go somewhere
slides.line: Earn at each place, spend as one balance: gift cards, airline miles, credit.

slides.headline: Offers only members see
slides.line: Partners run their own, on top of the three standing benefits.
